facts.text: Founded in 1846 as the Cherokee National Female Seminary, Northeastern State University is Oklahoma's oldest institution of higher learning.

sources.title: Heritage of Northeastern State University
sources.quote: Back in 1846, Northeastern State University was founded as the Cherokee National Female Seminary.

sources.title: Heritage of Northeastern State University
sources.quote: This historic link to the Cherokee Nation and Indian Territory make Northeastern the oldest institution of higher learning in Oklahoma.
